name: G1 Project Home and first run (slice S1)
description: A first launch with no SETUP step: every project here is created through the UI in a real window. The first-run tour shows on Project Home (Step 1 of 4), Next moves through it and highlights the Home region a step talks about, Skip tour closes it, and Help › Replay first-run tour brings it back (Done closes it). New Project creates a project in the default projects folder (the run's own Documents/EAK Projects, no folder dialog) by XTest typing its name; the project file is on disk. After File › Close project the Continue card shows that project with facts read from its folder, and its Needs attention item 'No design brief' opens the project on the Overview. The prompt box: XTest typing a description, Start shows the brief to review, and Create project and brief creates the project with the two sentences as its brief (one Batch of AddRequirement commands, no AI), listed in the Overview's Brief section. Open sample board builds the reference board through the engine's typed commands and opens its PCB; back on Home its Continue card lists 'ERC not run' (no saved report for that revision), and that item opens the project, runs ERC and shows Findings.
